description: Create a draft campaign with no steps, no leads and no mailboxes. `kind` is `sequence` (the default: any number of steps, follow-ups) or `one_time` (one step, sent once to the leads it holds at launch; it finishes when they are done, and it never grows by itself). It sends on weekdays from 08:00 to 18:00 (the workspace's time zone), at most 50 emails a day. Change those with update_campaign. An API key an owner limited to some campaigns can't create one (403, `details.scope: "keyCampaign"`).

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

kind.description: sequence (the default): steps with follow-ups, written to leads over time. one_time: one email sent once to its audience, with exactly one step and no follow-ups; it takes the members of its linked segments when it launches and finishes when they have all been written to. Fixed when the campaign is made.
